# Standalone examples in sitemap-core.xml ship testbeds, duplicate titles, and bare "Neo" names

## Context

Following `@tobiu`'s Prio-0 Search Console directive under `#20671`, auditing `sitemap-core.xml` and `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` on `origin/dev` (`537cfaf768b913371c8ec2f1ea009dc81182212c`) shows that standalone `{apps,examples}/**/index.html` routes account for `154` of `324` (`47.5%`) core sitemap URLs, yet receive no curation filter beyond `apps/portal/index.html` and `childapps?` and zero `seo.json` metadata entries.

`unowned-rationale: Prio-0 Search Console search-visibility work open for immediate maintainer swarm pickup; curated contributor labels omitted per ticket-create §4 urgent/critical rule.`

## The Problem

1. **Internal E2E witnesses and testbeds consume core crawl budget and `llms.txt`:**
   - Verified on `origin/dev` (`537cfaf768b913371c8ec2f1ea009dc81182212c`) via `git ls-tree -r --name-only 537cfaf768 apps/ examples/` filtered to `/index.html$` minus `collectExampleRoutes`'s two exclusions (`154` routes total, matching `sitemap-core.xml` output): internal harnesses `examples/dashboard/crossWindowWitness/index.html` (`<title>#15065 Cross-Window Witness</title>`) and `apps/ai/neural-link/index.html` (`<title>Neo.mjs Neural Link Testbed</title>`) — both already ruled `"not for the visitor catalog"` in `#21145` — are advertised at priority `0.8` in `sitemap-core.xml` and `llms.txt`.
   - Meanwhile `#21142` is actively evaluating which remaining standalone demos stay vs retire in the Engine 14 slate (`apps/route`, `apps/legit`, `apps/shareddialog`, etc.), so `collectExampleRoutes` needs a clean opt-out / config hook rather than hardcoded blanket exclusions that collide with `#21142`.
2. **Duplicate `<title>` tags across distinct `sitemap-core.xml` URLs:**
   - Parsing `<title>` across all `154` `{apps,examples}/**/index.html` files on `537cfaf768b913371c8ec2f1ea009dc81182212c` yields `151` unique titles because `"Neo Tree"` is duplicated `3×` (`examples/popover/index.html` copy-paste title, `examples/tree/index.html`, `examples/treeAccordion/index.html`) and `"Neo DateSelector"` is duplicated `2×` (`examples/component/dateSelector/index.html`, `examples/date/selectorContainer/index.html`).
3. **Zero `seo.json` metadata entries for standalone examples/apps (`0 / 154`):**
   - Inspecting `JSON.parse` of `git show 537cfaf768:apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` (positive control: `seo['/learn/benefits/Introduction']` present) returns `0` keys ending in `/index.html`.
   - Consequently `neomjs/middleware-v2` `SsrService.extractRouteMetadata` falls back to bare source `<title>`s (`"Neo Panels"`, `"Neo Clock"`, `"Conduit"`, `"Neo Video"`, `"Form"`, etc.), driving Search Console brand-collision queries (e.g. `"neo x panel"` hardware) instead of surfacing Web Worker / JavaScript UI context and curated `name` / `feature` / `lookFor` fields already present in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Design authority:** `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs:31-32` — *"Primary `sitemap-core.xml` and `llms.txt` outputs default to `includeArchives = false`, keeping crawl budget and LLM context windows focused on canonical documentation, blog posts, active release notes, examples, and apps."*
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:982-1007` (`collectExampleRoutes`): globs `{apps,examples}/**/index.html` and filters only `file !== 'apps/portal/index.html'` and `!/(?:^|\/)childapps?(?:\/|$)/.test(file)`.
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:1069-1331` (`getSeoJson`): builds `seo.json` for `/`, `/home`, `/learn/*`, `/news/blog/*`, `/news/releases/*`, and `/examples/<family>`, but never populates `/examples/.../index.html` or `/apps/.../index.html` (while line `1150` actively drops existing `/examples/` keys on rebuild).
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`: checks duplicate `<loc>` entries in `sitemap-core.xml`, but does not check duplicate `<title>` strings or excluded testbed/witness paths.
- Downstream consumer `neomjs/middleware-v2` `src/service/SsrService.mjs:382-394` preserves `seoEntry.title` / `seoEntry.description` from `seo.json` when present before falling back to `index.html`.
- Decision Record impact: none.

## The Fix

1. **Exclude non-catalog harnesses in `collectExampleRoutes` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs`):**
   - Exclude `#21145`'s confirmed non-catalog witnesses/testbeds (`examples/dashboard/crossWindowWitness/index.html`, `apps/ai/neural-link/index.html`) AND read an explicit opt-out signal (e.g. `neo-config.json` `seo: false` / `excludeFromSitemap` or explicit exclusion list) so `#21142` retirements opt out cleanly at source without breaking standalone execution.
2. **Fix duplicate copy-paste HTML `<title>` tags:**
   - Update `examples/popover/index.html` (`Neo Popover`), `examples/treeAccordion/index.html` (`Neo TreeAccordion`), and `examples/date/selectorContainer/index.html` (`Neo Date SelectorContainer`) so all `{apps,examples}/**/index.html` source titles are distinct.
3. **Populate `seo.json` metadata for every indexed `{apps,examples}/**/index.html` route in `getSeoJson()`:**
   - Join indexed `collectExampleRoutes` paths against `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` (`environments.devmode` / `sourceUrl`) to pull curated `name`, `feature`, and `lookFor` context, and qualify bare titles (`"Neo <X>"`, `"Conduit"`, etc.) with JavaScript UI / Web Worker / Multi-Window search-intent terms (`<= 68` chars, preserving non-framework Application Engine framing). Also check `apps/` key preservation in `getSeoJson()` line `1145-1157` so `/apps/.../index.html` keys are regenerated, not left stale or omitted.
4. **Harden `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` & unit specs:**
   - Assert `sitemap-core.xml` contains zero testbed/witness exclusions (`examples/dashboard/crossWindowWitness`, `apps/ai/neural-link`) and zero duplicate `<title>` values across indexed standalone examples/apps. Add tests under `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `collectExampleRoutes` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs`) excludes `examples/dashboard/crossWindowWitness/index.html`, `apps/ai/neural-link/index.html`, and any standalone app/example flagged to opt out (`neo-config.json`), reducing sitemap crawl-budget waste without conflicting with `#21142`'s pending catalog verdicts.
- [ ] All indexed `{apps,examples}/**/index.html` files carry unique source `<title>` tags (`examples/popover/index.html`, `examples/treeAccordion/index.html`, `examples/date/selectorContainer/index.html` fixed).
- [ ] `getSeoJson()` populates `title`, `description`, and `lastmod` in `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` for every indexed `/examples/.../index.html` and `/apps/.../index.html` route (reusing `examples.json` `feature` / `lookFor` when available and adding `Neo.mjs` Web Worker / JavaScript UI search-intent context without `"framework"` category drift).
- [ ] `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` enforces zero excluded testbed paths and zero duplicate `<title>` values across indexed routes, and SEO unit specs + `verify.mjs` pass cleanly.

## Out of Scope

- Deciding the `#21142` Engine 14 example slate (`keep` / `renew` / `retire` for user-facing demos like `apps/route`, `apps/legit`, `apps/shareddialog`, `examples/preloadingAssets`, `examples/sitemap`, etc.) or adding missing catalog records (`#20694`, `#20695`, `#20696`, `#21145`).
- Changing `SsrService.mjs` in `neomjs/middleware-v2` (once `seo.json` populates `/examples/.../index.html` and `/apps/.../index.html`, `SsrService` reads those entries directly).

## Avoided Traps

- Unilaterally deleting `#21142` catalog candidates (`apps/route`, `apps/legit`, `apps/shareddialog`, `apps/email`, `apps/finance`, etc.) from `sitemap-core.xml` before Clio's `#21142` slate rules on them: provide the source opt-out mechanism + testbed exclusions now, leaving catalog retirement decisions on `#21142`.
- Using `"JavaScript framework"` in qualified example titles (`AGENTS.md §neo_identity_anchor`).
